defs.def: a stage in a process of change or development 阶段；时期

ex.s: "The biggest challenge at the initial phase was to persuade people to work for me, which was totally outside my experience.
ex.t: ＂最初阶段最大的挑战是说服人们为我工作，这完全超出了我的经验范围。

ex.s: After this phase, they go out to try their legs.
ex.t: 在这个阶段之后，它们出去试跑。

ex.s: What do you do in the elaboration phase of the creative process?
ex.t: 在创作过程的细化阶段，你做些什么？

ex.s: Have you heard the 1 phrase / phase"Six Degrees of Separation"?
This knowledge will also be of no small advantage to him if he has passed through more than one intellectual or religious phase, widening the area of his appreciation and realisations.
ex.t: 如果他经历过不止一个思想或宗教阶段，这种知识对他来说也大有裨益，能拓宽他的鉴赏和领悟的领域。

defs.def: each of the shapes of the moon as we see it from the earth at different times of the month 月相；（月亮的）盈亏
